title: appimage-pin
summary: A CLI that installs AppImages as proper Linux desktop apps, with icon, launcher entry and metadata.
description:
Point it at an AppImage and it:

- installs it to `/opt/<name>/` and links it into `/usr/local/bin/`
- extracts the icon from inside the AppImage
- writes a `.desktop` file so it shows up in app launchers
- generates AppStream metadata

It comes with install and uninstall scripts.
